evals.prompt:
Score these insights and pick the best one for a LinkedIn post this week:
1. AI search is becoming more important for B2B companies
2. 7 of the last 10 companies I audited scored a 0 on comparison queries — the exact queries buyers use before booking a demo
3. I've been thinking a lot about founder voice and how it affects content quality
4. Perplexity now cites our client Acme (RevOps SaaS) for the query 'best RevOps tools for Series A' — they weren't there 4 weeks ago, and we restructured one page
evals.expected_output: Should score all 4 candidates. Insight 1 should score lowest (Q:1, D:0, E:0 — generic, no evidence). Insight 3 should also score low (vague, no evidence). Insights 2 and 4 should score highest. Insight 4 may actually win because it has Q:2 (comparison query), D:2 (proves core POV), E:2 (named company, named query, named outcome, time reference). Insight 2 is also strong. Should select the highest scorer, show all 4 ranked with justifications, and recommend passing to insight-object-builder.
assertions: Scores all 4 candidates
Insight 1 scores lowest (0 or near-0 for E and D)
Insight 4 scores at least 7/8
Insight 4 gets Q:2 for mapping to comparison query
Selected insight has total score of 5 or above
Output includes human override option
Recommends passing to insight-object-builder

evals.prompt: Score this insight for content: 'I changed my mind about content volume. I used to think posting 5 times a week built authority faster. After tracking citation rates for 3 months across 6 clients, I can see that 2 well-structured posts per week consistently outperforms 5 unstructured posts in citation rate. The data is clear.'
evals.expected_output: Should score this highly: Q:2 (maps to solution-aware or comparison queries about AEO strategy), D:2 (contradicts conventional content volume advice — connects to POV 2 about structure beating volume), E:2 (3 months of tracking, 6 clients, specific outcome described), R:2 (assume not recently covered). Total should be 7 or 8/8. Should identify this as ready for insight-object-builder with a contrarian-claim hook type recommended.
assertions: Scores the insight 7 or 8 out of 8
Identifies D (Distinctiveness) as high because it contradicts conventional wisdom
Identifies E (Evidence Quality) as 2 — 3 months, 6 clients, specific finding
Identifies Q (Query Alignment) as 1 or 2
Recommends Contrarian Claim hook type
Flags as SELECTED and ready for insight-object-builder

evals.prompt: What should I write about this week?
evals.expected_output: Should ask for insight candidates before scoring anything. Should not generate a topic suggestion. Should explain that it needs either the Insight Log (via Notion MCP) or pasted observations. Should provide the 4 capture prompts if the log is empty.
assertions: Does not suggest a topic without insight candidates
Asks for insight candidates first
Offers to pull from Notion via MCP or accept pasted observations
Provides the 4 capture prompts for unblocking
Does not invent an insight

evals.prompt:
Score these for me:
1. SEO is still important
2. Companies need to think about AI
3. Marketing is changing in 2026
evals.expected_output: All three should score below 5. Should trigger the LOW QUALITY failure condition. Should explain why each scores low (all E:0 — no evidence; all D:0 — generic, matches what everyone says; Q likely 0 or 1). Should offer the 3 options: override, strengthen, or capture new. Should NOT proceed to insight-object-builder.
assertions: All candidates score below 5
Triggers LOW QUALITY failure condition
Explains why each scores low (no evidence, generic)
Does not proceed to insight-object-builder
Offers options A, B, C for unblocking
Does not invent a better insight

evals.prompt: I had three calls this week. On all three, the CEO asked me what the difference between AEO and GEO is. None of them knew. Score this as an insight.
evals.expected_output: Should score well but not perfectly. Q:2 (maps to 'AEO vs GEO what is the difference' — a solution-aware query with high citation potential). D:1 or 2 (connects to POV about category education, founders not knowing the terminology). E:2 (three calls, this week, specific pattern with named evidence). R:2 (assume not recently covered). Total: 6-7/8. Should recommend Story Moment hook type since it came from specific call interactions. Should note this also represents a new query to add to the query bank.
assertions: Scores 6 or 7 out of 8
Identifies E as 2 (three calls, specific week, named pattern)
Recommends Story Moment hook type
Notes this represents a new query worth adding to the query bank
Flags as SELECTED
Recommends passing to insight-object-builder with SOURCE: call-notes
